_comment_format: Each company has: url (required), scenario (label for the table), notes (free text), expected_items (list of {url} the SDR manually curated as ground truth). Leave expected_items as [] for now — fill it in by visiting the site, copying real article URLs, and pasting them as {"url": "..."} entries. Companies with [] get status SKIP in the report. URLs are matched after normalisation (lowercase, strip https/www/trailing slash/fragment/query), so paste them however the browser shows them.
_comment_workflow: 1) Open the company URL in a browser. 2) Find a few recent news/blog/press articles you'd expect the pipeline to surface. 3) Copy each article's URL into expected_items. 4) Run: python scripts/scrape_batch.py 5) Read the report: missed = articles you curated but the system didn't find (the regression signal).
